log.msg: STORAGE DECIDED: JSONL, three committed files under public/imagine/importance/data/, one flat JSON object per line, no verb wrapper. The decisive reason is mechanical, not taste: Append.js resolve() returns null unless the path ends .jsonl, so a TSV could be read from the browser but never written from it, and building a server verb was out of scope. Plain fetch-split-parse rather than ext/JSONL: its verb model is one verb per line replayed into ONE object state, and these are three flat record streams, so a wrapper would add nesting to every committed row for a live() the pages do not need (both pages redraw from the in-memory store on activate).

CAR RANKING, read back by the CLI (node importance.mjs rank --context car): q1 'Has it been in an accident?' 100% of 3 judgments, rank 1. q2 'What color is it?' 0% of 3 judgments, rank 2. c1 'Carfax misses unreported accidents' unranked, 0 judgments, attached to q1 by a qualifies edge. Same numbers on screen — one Graph.js, one score() method, shared by the browser Store and the CLI FileStore.

SCHEMA CONFLICT RESOLVED: the owner's judgment table says winner is 'a' or 'b' but the worked example writes the node id (car q1 q2 q1 alice). The writer writes the ID (readable on its own line); Graph.won() reads both, so neither form can be misread. Written up in doc/storage.md.

CSS: prefix imp- is free (census over public/**.css and .js returned zero .imp-* hits). css-scopes.txt is outside this task's write fence, so the reservation line 'imp-         /imagine/importance' is recorded in doc/decisions.md for whoever can write styles/ next. View subclasses are named ImpRank/ImpTrace/ImpPropose/ImpPair so classify() mints .imp-rank/.imp-trace/.imp-propose/.imp-pair inside the same namespace.

TRAP AVOIDED: the lew42 skin styles every <button> 0.8em uppercase bold inside a hairline box, which would shout a question the reader is supposed to read. Every navigate/trace/choice control is a role=button span or div with its own Enter/Space handler (tap() in views.js); only the real Add action stays a <button>.

HEADLESS PROOF, keyboard judgment (private server PORT=8097, plan importance-keyboard.json): on judge/?at=car the pair chooser offered q2 vs c1 (not q1 vs q2 - the uncertainty rule prefers the unjudged caveat). Pressing the 1 key with focus on BODY appended one line; data/judgments/2026-09.jsonl went 3 lines to 4, read back by a cache-busted fetch: id jmu0i7ve0egs, context car, a q2, b c1, winner q2, judge you, weight 1, goal and reason present and empty. The judge screen immediately showed the NEXT pair (q1 vs c1) and the context view on next load showed q2 at 25% of 4 judgments and c1 at 0% of 1 - both changed by that one keypress. Zero console errors across the run.

HEADLESS PROOF, propose (plan importance-propose.json): typing 'Is the timing belt done?' and pressing Add appended TWO lines - the node to nodes.jsonl and its car-asks-it edge to edges.jsonl - the ranked list grew by one row (.imp-rank height +66px), and judge/ then offered the new question FIRST, unranked, which is deliverable 6's requirement. Trace also proven (plan importance-final.json): clicking rank 1 opened three rows, 'won over What color is it? - alice/bob/bot_7 - weight 1', bot_7's carrying its reason; clicking again closed it (+79/-79px).

BOTH TEST WRITES WERE THEN REMOVED from the committed files, so the shipped car example is exactly the owner's rows and a newcomer's first screen is the worked example. They were this session's own test artifacts in files this session created, not live history - the append-only rule governs judgments in use, and there is still no edit or delete path in the code. importance.mjs check reads 10 lines, 0 refused.

WIDTHS: 400 - no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 400 = clientWidth 400) and the two choice cards STACK (376px each, tops 234 and 360), which is the designed rem-floor fallback. 1280 - column body 601px, one screen, nothing below the fold. 3440 - column body 827px, no overflow. doc/storage/ renders through the doc/ route() with 0 .md-error and a real crumb trail. The offscreen-x flag on .imp-rank at 400 is the columns host scrolling the context column out of view while judge/ is open - by design, not a finding.

FENCE: git status over the whole repo shows exactly two new dirs (public/imagine/importance/, the task dir) and one modified file outside them - public/imagine/page.js, a one-line realm-name insert. Nothing in core/, ext/, styles/ or Server/; no npm dependency. The private server on 8097 (pid 31880) is killed at landing; port 80 never touched.

highlight.title: Importance, ranked by judgment
highlight.line: Questions, options and caveats under a topic, ranked by answering which of two matters more — humans and bots writing the same rows.

log.msg: LIVE LANDED - the one thing left is done. Store.open() now streams all three files through ext/JSONL's live(); the dev server's Tail.js pushes every appended line to every subscribed window. MEASURED: 9 ms and 10 ms across two runs, from the keypress in window A (judge/?at=car) to the ranked list changing in window B (/imagine/importance/?at=car), B hidden behind A and never touched. B went from 'q2 0% of 3, c1 unranked' to 'q2 25% of 4, c1 0% of 1'; A advanced to its next pair. Zero console errors. Same 9 ms /imagine/stream/ measures, because it is the same wire.

THE VERB MODEL WAS NOT THE OBSTACLE IT LOOKED LIKE. The original decision passed over ext/JSONL because its contract is one verb per line replayed into one object's state. But apply() is the single seam every line passes through, so a nine-line Rows subclass (rows=[]; apply(row){this.rows.push(row)}; reset()) takes flat records and the entire socket half - offsets, re-subscribe on reconnect, the tolerant parse, the content-type guard, jsonl_reset - comes free. The committed files did NOT change: still one flat JSON object per line, no verb wrapper. Correcting the earlier log line: the wrapper was never needed to get live().

CARET RULE PROVEN, not assumed. Three windows: A half-typed 'half typed reason' into judge/'s reason field, B half-typed 'half typed proposal' into the propose form, then C judged. Both fields read back their full text with selectionStart at 17 and 19 and document.activeElement still on them, while A's two confidence lines updated 100%/3->100%/4 and 0%/1->0%/2 seven ms after C's keypress. The split that buys this: .imp-live is the streamed region (trail, head, counts, ranked list) and is emptied per batch; the propose form, the reason field and the judge-name field sit OUTSIDE it and are never rebuilt.

THREE RULES THE LIVE PATH COST. (1) The writer does not apply its own line - append() sends and waits for it back off the wire, so there is one code path and the server is the only orderer (/imagine/stream/'s first Watch out, copied rather than rediscovered); the one concession is a 2s fallback that applies locally and warns, which never fires on a working server. (2) A control is never inside the streamed region. (3) Somebody else's judgment refreshes the two scores but does NOT move the pair under your hand - only my own accepted append advances to the next pair, told apart by a 'mine' flag because every judgment otherwise arrives identically.

TAIL DETAIL THAT REMOVED A WHOLE WORRY: Tail.subscribe() answers a MISSING file with an empty batch and leaves the subscription standing (its own comment says answering jsonl_reset would ping-pong). So subscribing to every month from 2026-09 costs nothing for months with no file, there is no stall and no console warning, and the first judgment of a new month streams to every open window the moment it is written. The one hole left - a window open ACROSS a month boundary writing to a shard it never subscribed to - is closed by Store.feed(), idempotent, called from append().

COMMITTED DATA BYTE-IDENTICAL after four test writes across three runs: shard back to the owner's three rows, nodes 4 lines, edges 3 lines, importance.mjs check 10 lines 0 refused, rank --context car reads 100%/3, 0%/3, unranked/0. git diff --stat over public/imagine/importance/data/ is empty. Files touched this round: importance.js (rewritten - Rows + open/sync/arrived/feed/expect/here), views.js (ImpPair both/restream/tally, ImpPropose no longer redraws), page.js (imp-live split, streamed(), store.watch), judge/page.js (streamed(), mine), importance.css (.imp-live), readme.md, doc/live.md (new), doc/page.js, doc/decisions.md. Fence unchanged.
